cases.name: Zur's Weirding
cases.text: If a player would draw a card, they reveal it instead. Then any other player may pay 2 life. If a player does, put that card into its owner's graveyard. Otherwise, that player draws a card.

cases.name: Example
cases.text: If a player would draw a card, they reveal it instead. Then any other player may pay 3 life. If a player does, put that card into its owner's graveyard. Otherwise, that player draws a card.

cases.name: Abundance
cases.text: If you would draw a card, you may instead choose land or nonland and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library in any order.

cases.name: Example
